summary: # Snapshot Refs and Selectors ## Purpose Refs are useful for discovery/debugging. For deterministic scripts, use selectors. For tap interactions, `press` is canonical; `click` is an equivalent alias. For host Mac desktop apps, pair this reference with [macos-desktop.md](macos-desktop.md) because context menus and native list/table structures need desktop-specific handling. ## Snapshot ```bash agent-device snapshot -i ``` Output:
